drafts.title: Authorization of Emergency Use of an In Vitro Diagnostic Device in Response to an Outbreak of Mpox; Availability
drafts.why: FDA EUA issuance for mpox IVD—direct regulatory action on diagnostic device authorization
drafts.summary: FDA issued an Emergency Use Authorization for the Allplex HSV-1&2/VZV/MPXV Assay, which can simultaneously detect and differentiate MPXV (clade I and II), HSV-1, HSV-2, and VZV from a single test. This builds on the HHS public health emergency determination made in August 2022 related to monkeypox. The assay is now authorized for emergency diagnostic use under the FD&C Act.
drafts.draft:
FDA just issued an EUA for the Allplex HSV-1&2/VZV/MPXV Assay, which does simultaneous detection and differentiation of MPXV (clade I and II), HSV-1, HSV-2, and VZV in one run.

The part that caught my eye as someone who works in diagnostics: that combination. Lesion presentations for these can look a lot alike clinically, so being able to rule in or out multiple targets at once matters for how quickly a clinician can act.

Still reading through the authorization conditions (those details are usually where the interesting constraints live).

drafts.why: POC respiratory test FDA submission—relevant to diagnostic device regulatory pathway

drafts.draft: Co-Diagnostics submitted a point-of-care respiratory infection test to the FDA. That's basically all the detail available right now, which is a little frustrating when you work in this space and want to know which targets, what platform, what claim they're going for. POC respiratory is a crowded space, so I'm curious what their angle is. Guess we wait for the clearance notice (or the next press release that actually has specifics).

drafts.title: At ADLM, Multimodal Point-of-Care System Makers Cubit Dx, Fluxergy Describe Accelerating Advances
drafts.why: Multimodal POC system advances—relevant innovation in point-of-care diagnostics
drafts.summary: At the ADLM conference, two multimodal point-of-care system makers, Cubit Dx and Fluxergy, described accelerating advances in their respective platforms. The article covers their presentations on progress in POC diagnostics.
drafts.draft: Caught a piece from ADLM about Cubit Dx and Fluxergy talking through where their multimodal POC platforms are heading. I don't have enough detail on the specifics yet to say much, but 'multimodal point-of-care' is a phrase I keep running into lately and I'm genuinely curious what that means in practice at the clinic or lab bench level (not just on a spec sheet). Something I'll be reading more closely.
